hero.heading: Innovating the Future Through Intelligent and Sustainable Technologies
hero.subheading: Uniting dynamic researchers, esteemed academicians, and global industry leaders to explore responsible AI, quantum computing, cybersecurity, and green tech.

usps.title: Convergence of Future Technologies
usps.description: Brings Generative AI, Quantum Computing, Cybersecurity, and Sustainable Computing together under one premier research umbrella.

usps.title: AI & Quantum Integration
usps.description: Encourages groundbreaking research at the vital intersection of quantum algorithms, machine learning, and high-performance computing.

usps.title: Security by Design
usps.description: Emphasizes trustworthy AI, privacy-preserving architectures, zero-trust paradigms, and post-quantum cryptographic resilience.

usps.title: Green & Responsible AI
usps.description: Spotlights energy-efficient models, low-carbon computational infrastructure, and environmentally sustainable technology lifecycles.

usps.title: Research with Real-World Impact
usps.description: Fosters experimental validation, open datasets, production deployments, and tangible solutions for agriculture, healthcare, and smart cities.

usps.title: Global Academic Networking
usps.description: Connects Indian researchers with eminent professors and research labs across USA, UK, Taiwan, Australia, Vietnam, and Singapore.

tracks.name: Generative AI and Intelligent Systems
tracks.scope: Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Multimodal Intelligence, Explainable AI (XAI), Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Intelligent Automation, and Responsible AI.

tracks.name: Quantum Computing & Emerging Paradigms
tracks.scope: Quantum algorithms, Quantum Machine Learning (QML), Quantum communication, Quantum cryptography, Quantum simulation, Hybrid quantum-classical computing, and Post-quantum technologies.

tracks.name: Cybersecurity, Privacy & Trustworthy Computing
tracks.scope: AI-driven cyber threat detection, Network security, Blockchain, Digital forensics, Privacy-preserving technologies, Secure communication, Post-quantum cryptography, and Zero-trust architectures.

tracks.name: Green Computing & Energy-Efficient Technologies
tracks.scope: Green AI, Low-power computing, Energy-efficient algorithms, Sustainable data centres, Cloud energy optimisation, Edge computing, Carbon-aware computing, and Renewable energy integration.

tracks.name: IoT, Cyber-Physical Systems & Smart Tech
tracks.scope: IoT, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Smart agriculture, Smart cities, Intelligent sensing, Embedded systems, Digital twins, Edge intelligence, and AI-enabled cyber-physical infrastructure.

tracks.name: Advanced Computing & Distributed Intelligence
tracks.scope: Big data analytics, Cloud and fog computing, Distributed systems, High-performance computing (HPC), Advanced algorithms, Data engineering, Knowledge discovery, and Intelligent information systems.

tracks.name: AI Applications & Interdisciplinary Innovations
tracks.scope: AI applications in healthcare, education, agriculture, finance, engineering, and industrial automation, including multimodal learning and domain-specific intelligent solutions.

tracks.name: Special Track: Best PhD Thesis Award
tracks.scope: Dedicated presentation track and cash awards for completed or near-completion doctoral dissertations in computer science, intelligent systems, and engineering.

registration.guidelines: At least one author must register with Full Registration fee to include the accepted paper in the conference proceedings. Co-authors and attendees may register under the Attendee category. Normal paper length is up to 12 pages in Springer Nature format. Each extra page is charged at ₹500 (INR) or $10 (USD).

about.overview: Acropolis Institute of Technology and Research (AITR), situated in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, commenced its journey of excellence in 2005. Spread across 5 Lakh square feet of lush green eco-friendly campus with globally acknowledged modern infrastructure, the institute is dedicated to high-standard education and interdisciplinary scientific research.

city.title: Welcome to Indore — India's Cleanest City
city.desc: Awarded India's cleanest city for 7 consecutive years under Swachh Survekshan, Indore is the cultural and commercial capital of Central India. Famous for its culinary hubs like Sarafa Bazaar and Chappan Dukan, as well as historic Rajwada Palace and Devi Ahilyabai Holkar Airport, Indore warmly welcomes international scholars.
